about: Timothy Cowans, an attorney with Scott Scriven LLP in Columbus, Ohio, helps clients address Workers' Compensation: Employer / Insurance situations. He also helps clients with Employment & Labor: Employer concerns.
He received legal training from The Ohio State University Michael E. Moritz College of Law. He graduated from law school in 1988. Timothy Cowans became licensed to practice law in 1988.
Timothy Cowans was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that he is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. He was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2006, 2008, 2021 - 2027.
